title: A Language Goes Extinct Every 2 Weeks
closing: When a language dies, a unique way of understanding the world disappears with it.
question: Do you speak more than one language?

segments.say: About four in ten languages are endangered, putting their last fluent speakers and entire worldviews at risk.
A language disappears about every 2 weeks as children stop learning it.
Half of today's languages could vanish by 2100, taking unique knowledge with them.
